value.rationale: This is the complete natural edge-fault classification of the smallest cubic prism for a nontrivial graph topological invariant. The two graph-edge orbits have equal deletion sizes but qualitatively different integral homotopy: a new nine-dimensional free third-homology group exists only after deleting a rung. The result extends the context of a known intact 64-four-sphere computation in a structurally meaningful, incidence-sensitive way, rather than a parameter-renaming or routine graph count. Its exactness and motivation survive without a general n-prism theorem.
